import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u058/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f209d160.py'

source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid) // 3
    m = len(grid[0]) // 3
    out = [[0 for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            colors = [grid[r][c]
                      for r in range(i * 3, i * 3 + 3)
                      for c in range(j * 3, j * 3 + 3)
                      if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
            if colors:
                out[i][j] = colors[0]
    return out
'''
with open(p,'w') as f:f.write(source)
